ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
Two drones, A and B, are conducting flight performance tests, flying along the same straight line in the same direction. At time $t=0$, the velocity of A is $v_{1}=16\mathbf{m}/\mathbf{s}$, and it is undergoing a uniformly decelerated linear motion with an acceleration of magnitude $a_{1}=2\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}^{2}$ for an "in-air stop" test (i.e., decelerating until it stops in the air). At this moment, B is located 18 meters behind A, with a velocity of $v_{2}=4\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}$ (in the same direction as $v_{1}$), and is undergoing a uniformly accelerated linear motion with an acceleration of magnitude $a_{2}=6\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}^{2}$. To avoid collision with A ahead, at $t=3\mathrm{s}$, B begins to undergo a uniformly decelerated linear motion with an acceleration of magnitude $a_{0}$ for an "in-air stop".

1. Find the magnitude of the displacement of A in the first 3 seconds, $x_{1}$
2. Find the maximum distance between A and B within the first 3 seconds.
3. To avoid collision, the condition for the acceleration $a_{0}$ when B starts to decelerate must satisfy:

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Set a common coordinate axis with positive direction along the drones' motion. Let A's initial position be x_A(0)=0 and B's initial position be x_B(0)=-18 m. For 0≤t≤3: x_A(t)=16t-(1/2)(2)t^2=16t-t^2, x_B(t)=-18+4t+(1/2)(6)t^2=-18+4t+3t^2. 1. A's displacement in the first 3 s is x_A(3)=16·3-3^2=48-9=39 m. 2. The separation during the first 3 s is d(t)=x_A(t)-x_B(t)=(16t-t^2)-(-18+4t+3t^2)=18+12t-4t^2. This is a downward-opening quadratic. Its vertex satisfies d'(t)=12-8t=0, so t=1.5 s, which lies in [0,3]. Thus d_max=d(1.5)=18+12(1.5)-4(1.5)^2=18+18-9=27 m. 3. At t=3 s, the positions are x_A(3)=39 m and x_B(3)=21 m, so the gap is 18 m. The velocities are v_A=16-2·3=10 m/s and v_B=4+6·3=22 m/s. Let τ=t-3 for the later phase. While both are moving, D(τ)=18+[10τ-τ^2]-[22τ-(1/2)a_0τ^2]=18-12τ+(a_0/2-1)τ^2. To avoid collision, require the minimum gap to be nonnegative. For the limiting convex case, D'(τ)=-12+(a_0-2)τ=0 gives τ=12/(a_0-2), and D_min=18-72/(a_0-2). Requiring D_min≥0 gives a_0-2≥4, hence a_0≥6 m/s^2.
